title: Fix native hook admission, encrypted output and Codex resume
body:
This PR moves ordinary hook enforcement to the native runtime and fixes admission, encrypted post-tool output, Codex approval resume and Copilot permission response delivery. Copilot permissionRequest and permissionRequestV2 now preserve the actual native availability denial, including its behavior, message, interrupt flag and reason, through the bounded daemon bridge. Previously that denial could be rendered as a generic Claude-shaped allow.

Current source is `a1d509404b0803a91031cb51f4b0c919408bfeba`, tree `e60dfd218cd7cc9f29c9f2cd66223c866ea86c80`, sole parent `b222318cca2811ac7ae90c7364e2ec6d0a10651f`. The normal CI build is `9f511875b236c12e5f23c783e958a536ac0360ba`, with the same complete tree. The latest commit changes only the Copilot bridge and its new regression module.

## Resulting behavior

- **Copilot permissions:** both supported permission event aliases preserve native denials under global and project registration. Existing pre/post-tool rendering, policy, deadlines and other harness responses retain their contracts.
- **Encrypted Pi/OMP output:** POSIX Rust reads the existing bounded encrypted reference without following links, verifies ownership, modes, file identity, content hash and AES-256-GCM authentication, checks the inner event and metadata, and evaluates the content under the original absolute deadline. Receipts retain the outer request commitment and reference kind. Windows encrypted references remain unsupported.
- **Daemon imports:** lightweight imports defer the seven manager exports until explicit access, while preserving all eleven public exports, shared state, reload and monkeypatch behavior. Manager side effects and import errors occur on first access; direct package-dictionary inspection can observe unresolved names.
- **Initial native admission:** a completely observed, stable empty command namespace can publish its first generation. Unknown, partial, symlink, nonregular or subsequently changed authority is refused.
- **Windows private-file replacement:** eligible systems use the reviewed POSIX replacement capability while preserving private-file checks and OS error semantics.
- **Risk reuse:** exact unchanged request inputs reuse category/signal work; authority, catalog, input or implementation changes invalidate it, including pending approvals and the final deadline fence.
- **Codex resume:** browser continuation uses the same two root transport timeout hints as initial ingress. Native revalidation remains bound to the original request, source identity, signed approval, current policy, deadline and replay checks.
- **Response contracts:** Cline, auxiliary events and registration fixtures cover JSON/stdout/stderr/exit behavior for posture, native misses, integrity and size failures, permissions and lifecycle events.

## Validation

The Copilot change passed **185 unique tests, zero skips**, including 36 new producer, renderer, malformed-input, other-harness and actual registration cases. Both original regressions were observed before correction. Ruff, formatting, typing and the existing semantic-callgraph and capability-cleanup gates passed. Root verified the exact two-file delta and both source reviews before publishing.

At **2026-09-20 22:16 UTC**, the current source has **31 successful normal workflows and one running original native workflow**, [35539716189](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35539716189). Windows and both Mac jobs passed; Linux remains in its original count-bounded soak, with the strict collector pending. The complete current-source workflow census and Linux artifact validation will be recorded after completion.

Current Windows artifacts passed independent review: 149 source cases, three POSIX skips, 53 mandatory cases, 90 child frames, 18 Unicode pairs and 21 accepted/processed native receipts. The separate `command_activity_persistence/sqlite_busy:1` observation is retained. Both Mac artifact sets have been verified against their actual build and package contents; independent review is in progress. These are ordinary CI results, with their original thresholds.

The completed **b222 parent** has all 32 normal workflows successful and 196 checks: 176 successful, 19 skipped and one rate-limited Kilo advisory failure. Its four authentic platform archives and strict collector passed independent verification. Linux completed 100,000 requests/responses and 250,000 receipts with zero errors, p95 549.58 ms and RSS growth 3.2207%. Its c16 p99 507.59 ms misses the original 200 ms qualification target. These results retain the b222/build 6aa63 identity.

Additional accepted evidence retains its actual source and execution identities:

| Installed Pi/OMP [35535394779](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35535394779) | Each POSIX cell passes 162 source cases, ten returned registered callbacks, six encrypted evaluations, ten exact committed receipt joins and owned-process cleanup. | Authentic 400/build 37fd wheels; selected Pi/OMP source-reference acceptance. Full route and approval matrices remain open. |
| Lazy imports | 393 passes and three existing Windows-only skips; full source typing has zero errors. | Functional import contract. Original performance benefit remains unproved. |
| Rust source census | 341 passes, six explicitly ignored diagnostics, zero failures across 347 unique cases in eighteen suites. | Actual retained parent run and exact provider continuity. |
| Codex continuation [35528764054](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35528764054) | Ninety source controls and one real continuation per POSIX cell, with durable approval and a fresh allow through the suspended response. | Authentic a5fd packages and the finite original scenario. |
| Secrets and archive handling | Four historical installed populations each pass 28 cases; current b222 logs establish another 72 archive/worker and fifteen CLI/staged source controls. | Installed entrypoints, staged-index divergence, exits 0/2/3, default and explicit limits, credentials, links, encoding, mutation and incomplete scans. |
| Risk reuse [35519707612](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35519707612) | Eight lanes pass thirteen positive and 49 approval cases; ten direct RSP099 cases pass. | Original e440 execution with unchanged product providers. |

Later isolated work is complete but has not yet been incorporated into the published task overlay:

- **Unix peer identity:** [35540033572](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35540033572) passes four parent cases on each POSIX platform, including actual owned-child socket exchange and refusal of a mismatched real peer before any authentication bytes. Original archives and independent review are complete. The two test-only source files are awaiting integration after the running normal workflow finishes.
- **Finite resource measurement:** [35540050314](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35540050314) passes all three private-memory prerequisite cases with 33 samples each, contained cleanup and independent artifact review. Missing private metrics remain null and fail the applicable minima. This establishes the measurement prerequisite; the original paired performance campaign has not run.

Earlier failed fixtures and diagnostics remain in the evidence record. Cline Intel still lacks normal pre-tool delivery at its original nine-second limit. The latest historical first-admission diagnostic still misses the original 400 ms boundary before a recovered request. Fresh current-artifact checks are being prepared with their original predicates; historical failures are not replaced by later results.

## PRD, TODO and Takeaway

The latest [published checkpoint](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/tree/23a8314814887086f6f37966361ea5cc7a12e286/review-evidence/2026-09-19/pr2974-completion/addenda/20260920T215600Z-b222-scopes-and-copilot-source) contains **15,430 verified leaves**, preserving all 14,256 prior leaves and adding 1,174. It includes immutable originals, source publications, complete parent CI/artifact verification, scoped decisions and retained failures.

The original 144 task objects and 119 catalog entries remain unchanged. The published overlay records **83 DONE, 22 OPEN, 29 BLOCKED and 10 DEFERRED**. Fifteen tasks have explicit support at the assessed b222 source: RSP001/006/007/013/014/015/022/047/069/071/079/099/100/120/133. Other archived DONE labels are not newly accepted at the current head. Functional or documentary acceptance keeps its own original dependencies and does not acquire a new global performance prerequisite.

Remaining work includes current-build completion; installed Cursor/Copilot registration delivery; Cline normal return and first-admission readiness; remaining route, workspace, external-permission and lifecycle matrices; the original performance and full-descendant resource populations; and version-bound signing, updater, rollback and canary qualification. The 50/100/200 ms limits, relative-benefit thresholds, sample populations and complete resource requirements are unchanged. Stopped E/F campaigns and completed historical populations are preserved.

The last complete review census has 51 COMMENTED reviews, zero approvals and all 59 threads resolved. Eligible CODEOWNER/last-push approval remains absent. The PR is open, mergeable and blocked; full PRD completion and release readiness remain open.
